title: Demonic Fox Sorceress
description: A female demonic fox-like character with black horns, multiple white and black tails, and glowing blue magic in her right hand stands dynamically amid a ruined battlefield. She holds a massive ornate black sword embedded with red energy and chains, surrounded by swirling red and black flames, embers, and broken stone structures.
prompt: A powerful female demonic fox sorceress with black curved horns, long black hair, and nine flowing white and black tails stands in a dramatic pose on a battlefield of ruins. She holds a gigantic ornate black sword with red glowing runes and chains in one hand while casting a bright blue magical orb with the other. Her outfit is revealing dark armor with red details and a white fur cape. The scene is filled with swirling red and black flames, floating embers, broken pillars and skulls, in a dramatic dark fantasy style with high contrast lighting.
